parts.stem:
David is comparing how quickly different solutes dissolve in water. He has two different solutes he wants to test: sodium chloride and sodium carbonate. He measures out 80 mL of room temperature water into two beakers.

Put the steps that follow into the correct order.

items.value: Measure the time taken for the solutes to dissolve.
Measure out 5 g of each solute.
Pour the second solute into beaker 2.
Stir both beakers at the same rate.
Pour the first solute into beaker 1.

correct_answer: Measure out 5 g of each solute.
Pour the first solute into beaker 1.
Pour the second solute into beaker 2.
Stir both beakers at the same rate.
Measure the time taken for the solutes to dissolve.
